text.offer: My knights ride where I cannot. One of them would gladly ride with you, if you ask it of me. Ask, and a knight will swear to you in my name.
text.progress: Stand before the Princess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: May they guard you as they would guard me. Their loyalty grows with every battle you share.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before the Princess and ask her for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
